author: ctdggd
body:
I like the update. Here are some problems I've found so far:
-The hub is big, and no more magic clock/click signs make it hard to maneuver. 
-/trails is a bit confusing. I only have 4 trails. Is that correct?
-in avicade: map themes like "Minotaur" are quite fun!  Well, unless there are afk people. A couple of days ago me and a couple of people were playing "Hell Bound" (that I think is the map, it's the one with nether crap).
So I died (meh), and eventually so did the Minotaur (someone clarify who was on).  The game, however, wasn't ending. We realized that there was 2 people sitting at spawn who were afk. Lucastacos and some other dude (thought i took a pic, but I guess not). Basically, this means the game wont end until a timer or they go un-afk and go. Not likely. Could there be like a death trap so if people are still at spawn, lava kills them?  It wouldn't wreck their k/d ratio too much, and it's a price they deserve if they aren't just gonna close in the middle of a game...
thanks.
